member.name: BookmarkMargin.Class
member.summary: Renders an icon beside every visible marked line and toggles a bookmark when the left mouse button is pressed.

remarks.para: The margin invalidates itself when its text view, visual lines, or scroll offset change and after it toggles a bookmark. A source that implements is followed while the margin is connected to a text view; a source without notifications requires the host to invalidate the margin after its bookmarks change.

A left-button press on a visual line's margin row requests a toggle for that line's bookmark through ; a press on a row without a visual line (for example past the end of the document) does nothing. The horizontal press position is not inspected.
The icon and the reserved width scale with the margin's font size.

The icon drawing is replaceable: the type installs a non-normative sample icon (an amber flag, see and ) as its authored default so the margin is visible without configuration. Assign and for the host's own identity, or override in a derived margin. The toggle decision is delegated to , whose default toggles through the source; a derived margin can override it to add modifier keys, confirmation, or a context-menu route.

member.name: SampleIconBrush
member.summary: Gets the sample icon brush the margin installs as its non-normative default: an amber brush suitable for a bookmark flag.
member.remarks: The default exists so a bookmark margin is visible without configuration. A host that wants its own identity assigns (or overrides the property's default value in a derived margin).

member.summary: Gets the test-only hooks of the margin. The member is and reachable only through InternalsVisibleTo, so the margin's public shape carries no test surface.

member.name: TryToggleBookmarkAt
member.summary: Runs the icon-click path for a margin-relative position without a routed event, exactly as the base margin's press handling does: the resolved line's toggle is requested, and the margin invalidates itself when the request is handled. A test seam, because a synthetic event cannot carry a deterministic position.
member.param: The position in the margin's coordinate space.
member.returns: when a line was found and the click was handled; otherwise, .

member.name: OnBookmarkToggleRequested
member.summary: Requests a bookmark toggle for the document line at the supplied offset and reports whether the request was handled.

remarks.para: The default toggles through and returns , so the margin invalidates itself and marks the click handled. A derived margin can override this member to apply a different gesture policy (modifier keys, confirmation, or a context-menu route); returning leaves the click unhandled and the margin uninvalidated.
The member is called only for a click that resolved to a visual line, so is the first document line offset of the clicked line.

member.param: The zero-based offset of the clicked line.
member.returns: when the toggle was performed; otherwise, .
